A curved, magenta line is drawn on a white background. The line starts near the left side and extends towards the right, slightly curved.
A pink, curvy, looping line on a white background. The line starts near the top, curves downward and to the right, and ends near the bottom.
A pink, curvy, looped line on a white background. The line is thicker on the left and thinner on the right.

nodes.asset_description: A cartoon figure with dark skin and short dark hair sits cross-legged, wearing a coral pink hooded sweatshirt and teal socks with white stripes. The figure holds a light purple book open with both hands, looking down at it with a slightly surprised or curious expression. The background is plain white.
A person with dark hair, wearing a yellow long-sleeved shirt and light pink pants, is seated and reading a light teal book with both hands. The background is entirely black.
A person with brown hair and glasses, wearing a teal polka-dotted shirt and purple pants, lies on their back holding an open book with both hands. They wear brown loafers. The background is white.

A stylized figure with green hair, a pink scarf, and a blue shirt is depicted in a floating pose, reading a yellow book. The figure has orange shoes with black stripes and is positioned against a white background.

A stack of five books with teal, blue, orange, and dark blue covers is shown against a white background. The books are arranged vertically, with the top book being green, the next two blue, the third yellow, the fourth teal, and the bottom book dark blue. The spines of the books are visible, and the pages are white.

Two open books are shown against a white background. The book on the left is teal with horizontal lines on the cover and a brown bookmark. The book on the right is pink with horizontal lines on the cover and a pink bookmark. Both books are shown with their pages open, revealing the white pages inside.

Two open books are displayed on a transparent background. The left book is teal with gold bands and orange accents. The right book is pink with cream pages and thin lines. Both books are oriented diagonally.

Two books are stacked on top of each other. The top book is yellow with a white cover and a rectangular label. The bottom book is teal with a white cover and a black spine. Both books are oriented horizontally.
An open book with cream-colored pages and dark lines is depicted against a transparent background of gray and white checkered squares. A red bookmark is positioned on the right page.

An open book with a red cover and cream-colored pages is depicted against a transparent background. The pages are arranged with horizontal lines indicating text. The book is positioned centrally, facing forward.

A closed book with an orange cover and a yellow leaf symbol on the front is shown. The book is angled slightly to the right, revealing its white pages. The cover has a dark red spine and edges. The background is transparent.
An open book with a peach-colored cover and a yellow band is shown against a white background. The pages are white and slightly curved, and the book is angled diagonally.

A dark blue hardcover book with a white label featuring three small white flowers is depicted against a transparent background. The book is closed and rests at a slight angle, revealing its white pages.
